title: Symbolic user functions with matrix results, dense, in the format of MatrixContainer
author: Claude-JG
description: The user functions that return a matrix cannot be symbolic: ObjectGenericODE2 massMatrixUserFunction and jacobianUserFunction, ObjectUserBody massMatrixUserFunction, positionJacobianUserFunction, rotationMatrixUserFunction and rotationJacobianUserFunction, ObjectFFRF and ObjectFFRFreducedOrder massMatrixUserFunction, ObjectConnectorCoordinateVector jacobianUserFunction. A recorded esym.Matrix result is evaluated directly into the MatrixContainer (dense) or the Matrix of the item, without the std::function and Python; the items call one EvaluateUserFunctionIntoMatrixContainer / IntoMatrix, as for the vectors (#3006), so that a sparse result (next step) fits the same path. Revision2026c step RG12.3.7.2.
releaseNotes: Symbolic user functions can return matrices: the mass matrices and Jacobians of ObjectGenericODE2 and ObjectUserBody, the rotation matrix of ObjectUserBody, the mass matrices of ObjectFFRF and ObjectFFRFreducedOrder and the jacobianUserFunction of ObjectConnectorCoordinateVector; the recorded esym.Matrix (also a list of lists or a numpy array of symbolic items) is evaluated without Python into the dense matrix of the item. An ObjectGenericODE2 with a 6 x 6 mass matrix user function solves nine times faster than with the Python function. Fixed: the component of a symbolic matrix product, (A @ B)[i, j], was refused.
